t: Giving AI Its Eyes: Automating Web Perception in Pipulate
s: Pipulate is evolving to equip AI agents with advanced browser automation capabilities, enabling richer, pre-processed web data for enhanced understanding and interaction, moving beyond simple web requests to a robust, notebook-centric system.
sub: Automated browser automation for AI web perception (Selenium, DevTools Protocol)
Notebook integration for AI context and executable payload (Python, JSON parsing, nbconvert)
Prompt engineering refinement and secret management for AI workflows
Pipulate's architectural alignment with AI/ML and financial/scientific Python ecosystems
